patterns.note: Alternating full-width dark and light background sections create clear visual breaks and content hierarchy, with content often centered or presented in clean grids.
Large, bold, sans-serif headings command attention, contrasted with smaller, legible body text and often uppercase, slightly lighter labels for sub-headings or categories.
A high-contrast palette of near-black and off-white dominates, punctuated by a subtle, muted teal/green accent for calls to action and key information.
As the user scrolls, content sections (text blocks, image cards, data visualizations) reveal themselves by fading in and subtly sliding up from the bottom as they enter the viewport.
Data visualization elements, such as progress bars and percentage displays, are integrated directly into content sections to highlight key metrics and outcomes.

technique_notes: Implement scroll-triggered animations using CSS keyframes or a JavaScript library to reveal content sections. Elements should fade in and translate slightly upwards as they become visible in the viewport.

The header navigation should be initially transparent and fixed, then transition to a solid background color and potentially a subtle shadow after a certain scroll threshold, maintaining its sticky position.
Utilize a full-bleed hero section with a very dark background (potentially a video) to establish a strong visual presence, transitioning smoothly to lighter content sections below.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold headings (especially in the hero) with a clear hierarchy, complemented by a clean, legible body text and smaller, often uppercase, labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners on interactive elements like buttons, input fields, and cards.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy, particularly in the hero and between major sections, creating a sense of calm and focus. Content blocks maintain a balanced density.

standout: The design's distinctiveness lies in its high-contrast, almost monochromatic aesthetic, leveraging a very dark (near black) background for impactful hero and key sections. This creates a sophisticated, editorial feel that strongly emphasizes the direct, data-driven value proposition, making it feel more like a premium service than a generic health app.
